post.summary: Delete old bulk comparisons up to the maximum number of items or a single comparison
post.description: An API that can only be called locally within an environment to allow it to be triggered by a cron job. It will delete bulk comparisons older than the specified number of business days while always keeping the latest 2. We take at least 10000 comparison people to delete at a time which may be one or more comparisons depending on if they were manual or not.

post.summary: Migrate sentence calculations from NOMIS into CRDS

Creates an entry in the legacy sentence calculation table for use in calculation history.
